setup_cmd: GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org go mod download && go list -test ./... >/dev/null
notes: Tests run via go-test-each (harness/docker/go-test-each.sh, baked into tc-go): every top-level Test/Example runs in its own test-binary process (test2json -> /out/go-test.json, 60s per test) so a panicking sabotage stub only fails the tests that actually reach it. Deps pinned by the repo's go.mod/go.sum (tidwall/match v1.0.1, tidwall/pretty v1.0.0, both 2017-2019) downloaded into the tc-cache-gomod volume during setup; tests run offline.
